title: When Less Latent Leads to Better Relay: Information-Preserving Compression for Latent Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
authors: Yiping Li; Zhiyu An; Wan Du
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: LatentMAS relays each agent's full KV cache to preserve richer inter-agent context, but the resulting memory and communication cost grows rapidly with the number of agents, rounds, and prompt tokens. Single-agent online KV eviction methods do not directly address one-shot compression at an inter-agent relay boundary.
problem_statement.zh: LatentMAS 透過 relay 每個 agent 的完整 KV cache 來保留更豐富的跨 agent context，但其記憶體與通訊成本會隨 agent 數量、round 與 prompt token 數快速成長。面向單一 agent 線上推論的 KV eviction 方法，無法直接處理 agent 間 relay boundary 的一次性壓縮。

key_innovation.en: Orthogonal BackFill (OBF) selects prompt KV positions by accumulated attention from the current latent reasoning states, isolates a low-rank PCA residual of discarded values that is orthogonal to the retained value span, scales it by deleted-versus-retained attention demand, and injects it into all retained values.
key_innovation.zh: Orthogonal BackFill (OBF) 先依 current latent reasoning state 的 accumulated attention 選取 prompt KV position，再抽取相對於 retained value span 正交的 discarded value 低秩 PCA residual，依 deleted-versus-retained attention demand 縮放後注入所有 retained value。

key_improvements.en: With only 9.9%–20.2% of prompt KV states retained, H-OBF achieves 97%–120% of full-KV relay accuracy across nine benchmarks. Using the accuracy-maximizing PCA rank selected per dataset from {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, H-OBF and L-OBF exceed Full by 1.7 and 1.9 percentage points on average, respectively, with L-OBF reaching a 13.33-point gain on AIME 2024.
key_improvements.zh: 僅保留 9.9%–20.2% 的 prompt KV state 時，H-OBF 在九項 benchmark 上仍達到完整 KV relay accuracy 的 97%–120%。各 dataset 由 {2, 4, 8, 16, 32} 選取 accuracy 最高的 PCA rank 後，H-OBF 與 L-OBF 平均分別較 Full 高 1.7 與 1.9 個百分點；L-OBF 在 AIME 2024 上最高提升 13.33 個百分點。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition, NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation
gpu_count: 2x NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB per cluster node; 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition; 2x NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada Generation

reuse_metric.en: H-OBF retains 9.9%–20.2% of prompt KV states while delivering 97%–120% of full-KV relay's per-benchmark accuracy across nine benchmarks, using the accuracy-maximizing PCA rank selected separately for each dataset from {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}.
reuse_metric.zh: H-OBF 僅保留 9.9%–20.2% 的 prompt KV state，仍在九項 benchmark 上達到完整 KV relay 每項 accuracy 的 97%–120%；其中各 dataset 分別由 {2, 4, 8, 16, 32} 選取 accuracy 最高的 PCA rank。
